seed.label: methylKit user guide
seed.provenance_unresolved: Bundled example counts; observed versus simulated origin unresolved. Not labeled as observed biological measurements.

input_origin: Downloaded from inst/extdata/ of the pinned methylKit revision; exact URLs in input-manifest.json of the authoring workspace. Redistribution terms follow the package's Artistic-2.0 license; no additional download permission was granted or needed (files are redistributed with the task as permitted inputs).
reductions: Only the seed's coverage-filtering, complete-case joining and group-comparison sections are used; alignment, segmentation, differential testing and annotation are out of scope.

methRead(mincov=10) plus filterByCoverage(lo.count=10, hi.perc=99.9) collapse into a single stated filter: coverage >= 10 (inclusive) and coverage < the sample's type-7 99.9th percentile of the low-passing coverages (upper bound exclusive, as implemented by methylKit's filterByCoverage).
unite(destrand=FALSE) is expressed as a complete-case join keyed by (chr, base, strand).
Percent methylation is defined from reconstructed integer methylated counts (round half to even) rather than the file's 2-decimal freqC values.
Group aggregation is an unweighted mean of per-sample percentages; no pooling of raw counts and no significance testing.

reference.native: methylKit 1.33.3 (source revision 32212a6cc2046e97371eb528533964c1e1a54afa) on R 4.5.0 (debian trixie); reference run recorded in native-reference/
reference.independent: task/solution/solve.sh re-implements the pipeline with data.table only and is compared key-by-key against the native reference

verification.grader: task/tests/grader.py, deterministic key-based comparison against expected values with absolute tolerance 0.05 percentage points
verification.expected_asset: task/tests/expected/group_methylation.tsv derived from the native reference; hidden from the solver image
